title: Claude built a model it says is too dangerous to release
description:
In 2019, an AI model was famously held back as too dangerous to release. Now Claude is about to do the same with its new model, Mythos. Here is what we know about Anthropic's most controversial model yet, what it might do, and how you will be able to use it the day it goes live.

Claude AI keeps moving fast, and this could be the biggest drop since Fable 5. Stay ready.

Get the full Mythos breakdown here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1BdQhxe9Mv-gi9NCUEGBV5O2lcxrf23cp/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=110897400342351178452&rtpof=true&sd=true
